response.sql: WITH per_media_type AS (SELECT mt.Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 GROUP BY mt.Name) SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) FROM per_media_type

assumptions.assumption: Tracks with zero milliseconds have an undefined bytes-per-millisecond rate and are excluded from the averages.
